meta.title: MBA in Investment Banking in Mumbai – ATLAS ISME
meta.description: Study investment banking, valuation, markets, risk, analytics, financial strategy and skills for global finance roles.

panes.label: Overview
text: The MBA in Investment Banking at ATLAS ISME is

text.strong: India’s first industry-endorsed program that blends academic excellence with real-world deal execution.

text: Designed in close collaboration with leading bankers and capital market experts, this two-year program

text.strong: prepares students to work on high-stakes transactions like M&A deals, IPO mandates, and private equity investments.

text: Through a future-focused curriculum and live deal-room simulations, students gain hands-on experience in

text.strong: valuation techniques, financial modeling, regulatory compliance, and risk management.

text: The program is structured to bridge theory with practice—featuring workshops on

text.strong: DRHP drafting, SEBI & LODR guidelines, fintech integrations, and ESG trends.

text: With direct mentorship from senior professionals and a six-month internship built into the curriculum, graduates emerge career-ready for global roles across investment banks, advisory firms, and capital markets. What sets this program apart is its guaranteed placement support, practitioner-led pedagogy, and access to India’s most powerful financial networks.

semesters.title: Semester 1
semesters.text: Gain a rigorous introduction to the foundations of investment banking, accounting, economics, and financial markets. This semester focuses on building analytical and business communication skills essential for a career in finance and investment banking.

courses.text: Explores primary and secondary markets, securities instruments, and trading mechanisms. Students analyze market structures and investment strategies.
Covers investment banking functions, capital raising, M&A advisory, and underwriting processes. Students examine real-world IB transactions and case studies.
Teaches interpretation of balance sheets, income statements, and cash flows. Students assess company performance and make informed investment decisions.

title.strong: Excel for Decision Making + AI Tools

courses.text: Develops financial modeling and analytical skills using Excel and AI tools. Students perform scenario analysis and data-driven investment decisions.
Applies micro and macroeconomic concepts to managerial decisions. Students evaluate market behavior, pricing strategies, and resource allocation for investments.
Introduces probability, regression, and hypothesis testing for business decision-making. Students analyze data for financial forecasting and investment analysis.
Covers internal and external corporate communication strategies. Students develop messaging for stakeholders, investor relations, and media engagement.
Introduces capital structure, time value of money, and financing decisions. Students learn to value projects, analyze risk, and optimize financial strategies.

compare.title: Why our Semester 1 curriculum outpaces every other business school
compare.text: ATLAS ISME combines applied financial analysis, AI tools, and global business insights, contrasting theory-heavy, lecture-based investment banking programs.

semesters.title: Semester 2
semesters.text: Develop expertise in financial management, corporate finance, and advanced regulatory frameworks, while deepening practical skills through hands-on labs and a focus on analysis of both equity and debt markets. The curriculum emphasizes compliance, ethics, and real-time market analysis.

title.strong: Corporate Governance and Compliance under Companies Act 2013

courses.text: Introduces governance principles and compliance requirements under the Companies Act 2013. Students understand corporate responsibilities and legal frameworks.

title.strong: IPO and Capital Raising under ICDR I

courses.text: Covers IPO processes and capital raising under ICDR regulations. Students learn issue management and regulatory aspects.
Teaches interpretation of financial statements. Students evaluate a company's performance and financial health.
Focuses on advanced finance concepts like valuation and capital budgeting. Students evaluate strategic financial decisions.
Develops skills in building financial models for analysis and forecasting. Students support investment decisions using structured tools.
Introduces derivatives and risk management techniques. Students learn to manage financial risks effectively.
Covers evaluation of securities and portfolio construction. Students apply risk-return and diversification strategies.
Introduces research methods and data analysis tools. Students use data to support financial decision-making.

semesters.title: Semester 3
semesters.text: Advance into specialized banking operations, M&A, and capital markets topics, blending analytical skills with practical case study projects. Students build a strong understanding of risk management and deal execution processes essential for investment bankers.

title.strong: IPO and Capital Raising under ICDR II

courses.text: Focuses on advanced IPO structuring and regulatory compliance under ICDR. Students analyse real case scenarios in capital raising.
Covers financial, legal, and business due diligence processes. Students evaluate companies for investments and strategic decisions.
Introduces SEBI listing regulations and disclosure norms. Students ensure corporate transparency and regulatory compliance.
Focuses on company valuation and mergers and acquisitions strategies. Students assess deals using financial modelling and analysis.
Covers taxation laws relevant to corporate finance and investments. Students analyse tax implications for business decisions.
Explores psychological factors influencing financial decisions. Students examine investor behaviour and market anomalies.
Introduces digital finance, blockchain, and emerging technologies. Students evaluate innovations in banking and financial services.
Covers environmental, social, and governance principles in finance. Students analyse sustainable investing and responsible business practices.
Develops professional conduct and communication skills. Students learn corporate etiquette and client interaction standards.

semesters.text: Apply advanced banking knowledge through real-world projects and internships, with a focus on global investment banking, strategic advisory, and portfolio management. The curriculum prepares students to confidently step into industry roles and leadership positions

courses.text: Provides practical industry exposure through a structured internship. Students apply classroom knowledge in real-world financial settings.
Offers hands-on learning through expert-led sessions. Students gain practical insights into current industry practices and tools.
Develops proficiency in MS Office tools for financial analysis and reporting. Students enhance productivity and data handling skills.

courses.text: Introduces the structure and drafting of DRHP documents. Students learn disclosure requirements and documentation for public issues.
Covers the usage of financial databases for research and analysis. Students access and interpret market and company data effectively.
